animate_calls.note: v2: 35 call sites → A-01…A-30 and A-36…A-41 (fx() is shared by A-18 shine and A-19 ripple; A-15 is now startMarquee). TradeApplication: A-31…A-33. EnquiryForm: A-34, A-35. indus-logo.js: L-01…L-09.

inline_transitions.note: One TR record per template transition declaration, regenerated from the template on 2026-10-11 (v2: 107 in the template; 1 in the logic class: buildScatter cssText, dead code, J-19). J-10 adds a translate transition at runtime.

pseudo_rules.note: style-hover / style-focus attributes. A rule on an element that also has a transition is folded into that TR record; elements with pseudo rules but no transition are PS records (instant).

css_animations.note: 1 'animation:' declaration in the v2 template (tpl 407) is 'animation:none'; 0 @keyframes in all three files. The three helmet reduced-motion rules (RM-01…03) set transition/animation durations but declare no animation.

js_style_writers.note: Inline style writes, text writes, scroll calls and playbackRate changes made from JS outside .animate(). indus-logo.js and setHeroSvgEl also set static setup styles on the inlined SVGs (display, size, transform-box, transform-origin); those are layout setup, not effects. 2026-10-11: J-20 drawer section scroll, J-21 careers scroll-to-form, J-22/J-23 range peek custom properties; marquee currentTime/playbackRate carry-over is part of A-15.

runtime_trace.viewport: 1400×900 (state.w forced to 800 for the drawer phase)
runtime_trace.method: Element.prototype.animate patched before boot (stack frame → file:line); inline style changes diffed with a MutationObserver; transitionrun listener. Every route visited and scrolled; every [data-mag]/[data-tilt] driven with synthetic pointer events; menus, drawer, accordions, testimonial, FAQ, blog filter, inline form, TradeApplication steps/shake/submit and EnquiryForm shake/sent driven through setState or the logic methods.

runtime_trace.note: The trace ran before the 2026-10-10 fixes (revision_traced). The fixes added reduced-motion guards, the marquee exclusion and the pulse colour; they added no elements, so data-dc-tpl ids are unchanged. Source lines were re-resolved against the current files. Call counts are from the earlier run; re-run the harness to refresh them.

unresolved.reason: Fixed 2026-10-10: every Web Animation in the three drafts and indus-logo.js now checks prefers-reduced-motion, and RM-01…03 make CSS transitions instant. The harness cannot emulate the setting, so these values come from the code. Still running under reduced motion by design: scroll-linked writes (J-02 progress bar, J-04…J-08 pinned timeline) and the testimonial auto-advance (A-01 content changes without animation).

Synthetic events cannot produce CSS :hover or :focus, so hover/focus TR and PS records are not-instrumented. Their values come from style-hover/style-focus in the template. TR records for tpl 433 and 606 were observed only because a real pointer rested over the preview during the run.

The trace ran at 1400px. A-07…A-09 choose targets by computed style, so their tpl lists are desktop observations. Tablet and mobile layouts (native swipe timeline, drawer-only navigation, single-column grids) change which elements qualify; they were not traced by resizing.

In logo-square-anim.svg, logo_text has a single child (path1), so in the footer L-06 and L-09 move the whole wordmark as one piece instead of staggering letters. This may be how Bean's file is built; confirm with Bean.

Range tiles now use matching Unsplash photos (rice, flour, spices, lentils, dried fruit and nuts, spice blends, chilli powders, lemon and chilli, herb jars, beans, spice jars, rusks, breads, biscuits) via applyStock. Replace with Indus Foods product photography before launch; "Recipe mixes", "Pantry staples" and "Delicatessen" are the loosest matches.
The three roles in pages.careers (roles const) are placeholders. In WordPress this block should read live vacancies; when the list is empty the noRoles message shows.
Records with trace.observed "no" and the 2026-10-11 note (A-14, A-15, A-36…A-41, J-10, J-20…J-23) and all regenerated TR/PS records were not re-traced. Values come from the code.
